Implementation Plan

I've written the plan for issue #9784 below. It's a one-file change. Planning ran against `main` at `d03c0db09e845eae063540d4b39afb2e1082488e`; the integration branch mismatch value was `unknown`, not `true`.

## Plan: rewrite `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` to the three-line spec

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: this is a test fixture data file, so no workflow behaviour changes after merge.

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This only changes data.

The file on the planning ref currently holds two lines, each ending in LF:
```
status: ok
decompose-run: 41445772297
```

Replace the whole content with exactly:
```
status: ok
run_id: alt-44490333814
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```

- Use LF line endings and end the last line with one newline, the same as the current file.
- Don't add a BOM and don't leave trailing spaces.

## Data structures affected
Only the canary text file.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — End the file with a trailing newline
- Chosen: end the last line with a single LF.
- Alternatives considered: no newline after the last line.
- Why: the current file ends its last line with a newline, and text files in this repo use LF. The issue says "exactly these three lines", and three newline-terminated lines is the usual reading of that.

## Security considerations
No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or money handling is involved. The new value contains no credential.

## Risks and edge cases
- `tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py` compares the canary byte for byte against `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_spec.txt`. It only runs in Phase 4b, when the `E2E_CANARY_FILE` environment variable is set, so normal CI isn't affected.
- Other tests mention the canary path, but none checks this file's content in normal CI. A trailing-newline mismatch would only matter to an external checker.

## Testing considerations
Check that the file's bytes equal `status: ok\nrun_id: alt-44490333814\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n`, and that `git diff --stat` shows only this file changed.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies a content replacement in one existing file and forbids touching anything else. That is the complete change, so there is nothing to widen or cut.
